global: {player} burned {village} to the ground. Nice work, really. Every merchant on the east road just got a little poorer.
Lost the whole wool harvest in {village} to {player}'s torches. Prices in the market will feel that.
Fire at {village} means no grain for three towns. Somebody tell {player} the bread price is on them now.
Anyone planning to trade near {village}? Stay away from {player} until the road is safe. Learned that the hard way.
Insurance does not cover arson by {player}. Who knew. Every caravan will now pay double for escorts.
Ask me again why I hate open raiding. {village} is the reason, and {player} is the name on the ashes.
Raids like {player}'s cost more than the loot is worth. Ledger says red, and I am keeping score.
{village} is ash. Traders, route your wagons around {player}'s band. I am not joking about the tolls.
whisper: {player}, you burned {village} and my profits with it. I will remember the smell of that smoke.
Rude. Very rude. I had a shipment of salt waiting in {village}. Now I have ash and a grudge.
I could have sold you horses at a fair price, {player}. Now you can buy them from someone else at my markup.
Expect my caravans to avoid your roads from now on. I will not be trading with you until this is made right.
Burning {village} was a poor investment, {player}. Worst return I have seen all season, and I have seen a few.
Do not message me asking for a discount. The only discount you will get is the one I give to the road guards.
{player}, I am writing down every wagon you have cost me. The total is long and it is not getting shorter.
Stay out of {village}'s market from now on. You are not welcome to buy, sell or pass through it.

global: Word from {village} is the market is closed until the smoke clears. Wary traders, mind the roads near {player}.
Charcoal and ash both went up this week after {village} burned. Not blaming anyone yet, {player}.
Lost a cart near {village} this morning. Still not sure if {player} saw it or just got lucky.
Rebuilding {village} will raise the cost of lumber for everyone. Hope the next raid is smaller, honestly.
Keeping my wagons off the east road for now. Nothing personal, {player}, just the usual caution.
Caravans are asking which villages are safe this week. {village} is not on that list anymore.
Anyone buying timber from {village} survivors, come talk to me. I pay fair and fast.
Business as usual in the south. Just watching the roads a little more closely since {village} went up.
whisper: {player}, I am not saying it was you. I am saying the timber from {village} has gone up and I am watching the roads.
No hard feelings yet, {player}. Business is business, but I would like to know your plans before I send another wagon out.
Heard the fire in {village} was big. If you want to make it right, sell me a few horses at cost and we can call it even.
I will keep my caravans off roads you are using for now. Let me know if that changes, and I will be happy to talk prices.
Still want to trade, {player}? I can offer a better rate on iron than anyone else in the region. Mind the tolls though.
Tell me honestly, {player}, do you plan on passing through {village} again? It matters for my route planning.
Ash does not sell well, {player}. If you want goods moved out of the region, I can arrange escort for a fee.
I am weighing whether to keep trading with you. Give me a reason to believe this was a one off, and we will see.
